Note.SaveStateName: Auto-save status; click to retry if saving failed

Error.SaveFailedBody:
This note has not been saved successfully (the disk may be full or the file is in use).

OK: discard the changes and close the window.
Cancel: stay on the note, then click the status bar at the bottom to retry, or copy the text and close manually.

Archive.Hint: Archived notes are hidden from desktop stickers and the main list. You can restore or permanently delete them.
Archive.EmptySubtitle: Archive a note from the note manager or a sticker window and it will be stored safely here
Archive.HardDelete: Permanently delete this note (cannot be undone)

Confirm.HardDelete:
Permanently delete this note?
This cannot be undone and the data will be lost.
Confirm.ClearAll:
Permanently delete all archived notes?
This will remove every archived note and cannot be undone.

Pin.HintDefault: Enter your PIN and press Enter to unlock
Pin.ForgotBody:
The PIN is lightweight protection against casual snooping; there is no in-app recovery.

To reset it: exit the app, open settings.json in the data directory,
remove the "PinEnabled", "PinSalt" and "PinHash" fields, save, then restart.

Setup.SetSubHeader: You will be asked for the PIN when opening the note list or archive (4-20 characters, lightweight protection)
Setup.ChangeSubHeader: Verify the current PIN first, then enter a new one (4-20 characters)
Setup.ClearSubHeader: Enter the current PIN to verify, then PIN lock will be turned off

Error.Length: The new PIN must be {0}-{1} characters
Error.Mismatch: The two new PINs do not match
